header: Headline and text, then a row of figures
lead: Two to four numbers under the text, each with a label and optional unit. All figures share one size, whatever their number of digits.

metrics.title: Minimum figures
metrics.text: One figure works better as a sentence.

metrics.title: Maximum figures
metrics.text: Readers stop taking in figures after four.

metrics.title: Type size
metrics.text: Every figure uses it, however many digits it has.
